zh: 英语字母表的第 24 个字母
（代表未知数）
未知的人（或数、影响等）；未指明的人（或数、影响等）
en: the 24th letter of the English alphabet
ex: ‘Xylophone’ begins with (an) X/‘X’.
xylophone 一词以字母 x 开头。

zh: a label that was given in the past to certain cinema films in Britain by the British Board of Film Censors (now called the British Board of Film Classification). Films were given an X certificate if they were not considered to be suitable for people under 18, usually because they contained violence, sex or bad language. In 1982 the label 'X certificate' was changed to '18’.
en: a label that was given in the past to certain cinema films in Britain by the British Board of Film Censors (now called the British Board of Film Classification). Films were given an X certificate if they were not considered to be suitable for people under 18, usually because they contained violence, sex or bad language. In 1982 the label 'X certificate' was changed to '18’.

zh: X 染色体
en: a sex chromosome. Two X chromosomes exist in the cells of human females. In human males each cell has one X chromosome and one Y chromosome.

zh: 特质，X 因素（尤指获得成功所必需又难以描述的素质）
en: a special quality, especially one that is essential for success and is difficult to describe
ex: She certainly has the X factor that all great singers have.
她确实具备所有伟大的歌唱家所拥有的特质。

zh: a US make of knife with thin steel blades (= cutting edges) which can be changed. It is used for careful work, for example, by artists to cut paper accurately and by people building model aircraft.
en: a US make of knife with thin steel blades (= cutting edges) which can be changed. It is used for careful work, for example, by artists to cut paper accurately and by people building model aircraft.

zh: 用 X 射线拍摄检查
en: to photograph and examine bones and organs inside the body, using X-rays
ex: He had to have his chest X-rayed.
他得做胸部 X 光检查。

zh: 黄原胶，三仙胶（使食物变稠的化学物质）
en: a chemical substance that is put in food to make it thicker

zh: 氙；氙气
en: a chemical element. Xenon is a gas that is found in very small quantities in the air and is used in some special electric lamps.

zh: 仇外，惧外（对外国人的厌恶或惧怕）
en: a strong feeling of dislike or fear of people from other countries
ex: a campaign against racism and xenophobia
反对种族主义和仇外情绪的运动

zh: 仇外，惧外（对外国人的厌恶或惧怕）
en: feeling or showing dislike or fear of people from other countries
ex: xenophobic slogans
仇外口号

zh: （从动物到人体的）异种移植
en: the process of taking organs from animals and putting them into humans for medical purposes

zh: 复印；影印
en: to make a copy of a letter, document, etc. by using Xerox™ or a similar process
ex: Could you xerox this letter, please?
请把这封信复印一份好吗？

zh: 复印
复印件
en: a process for producing copies of letters, documents, etc. using a special machine
ex: a Xerox machine
复印机

zh: 希腊字母表的第 14 个字母
en: the 14th letter of the Greek alphabet (Ξ, ξ)

zh: 湘语；湘方言；湖南话
en: a form of Chinese spoken mainly in Hunan

zh: （尤指服装的尺码）特大号
en: extra large (used for sizes of things, especially clothes)
ex: an XL T-shirt
一件特大号 T 恤衫

zh: 极好的，妙极了（全写为 excellent，尤用于社交网络信息和互联网）
en: (used especially in social media and on the internet) excellent
ex: XLNT point!
这一点说得太好了！

zh: points that you earn in a computer game (the abbreviation for ‘experience points’)
en: points that you earn in a computer game (the abbreviation for ‘experience points’)
ex: You get XP for killing monsters and completing quests.
您会获得杀死怪物并完成任务的经验值。

zh: extra small(used for sizes of things, especially clothes)
en: extra small(used for sizes of things, especially clothes)

zh: 木质部（植物中将水分和矿物质从根部向上输送的组织）
en: the material in plants that carries water and minerals upwards from the root

zh: 木琴
en: a musical instrument made of two rows of wooden bars of different lengths that you hit with two small sticks
